assets.scene: Show doing one thing and THEN the next: two equal views of the SAME child at a kitchen sink/table, first washing hands on the LEFT, then eating a slice of apple on the RIGHT. A very clear broad curved arrow goes from the first action to the second. The first is softly desaturated while the second is in full coral and blue color, emphasizing the next action after the earlier one. Same child, same clothes and scale; do not imply competition, final victory or a countdown. One coherent everyday action sequence, no numbers, captions or panels.

candidates.scene: Illustrate WHEN rain starts, a child opens an umbrella, in one coherent scene connecting condition-in-time and action. A child stands on a path at the boundary between dry ground and falling rain, raising and opening a blue umbrella just as the first large raindrops arrive. A small earlier faded silhouette of the SAME child holding the folded umbrella remains to the left in dry air; a short arrow joins it to the main umbrella-opening action under the first rain. Clear simultaneous timing at onset of rain, no sunbathing or unrelated event. No words or symbols of clocks.

candidates.scene: A child wearing a bicycle helmet stands with a small bicycle at an open park entrance looking for permission. An adult guardian at the gate looks kindly at the child, smiling and visibly nodding with a clear thumbs-up and an open welcoming palm toward the safe empty path, ALLOWING the child to enter. Child is about to move, not yet cycling. The permission gesture is large and central, no prohibitory signs, no written symbols. The scene should clearly convey being allowed/can do something, not physical strength or ability.
